hook: Your trek here ends in a forest of black dead trees.
title: Your Trek Ends in a 900-Year-Old Dead Forest
description:
Deadvlei in Namibia is a white clay pan filled with black dead trees under huge red dunes. The trees are roughly 900 years old. The air is so dry they never rotted away.

#Shorts #Namibia #Geography
comment_prompt: Would you trek here? Yes or no
